Question
========
What is one benefit of adding metadata to datasets?

Answerlist
----------
* It decreases storage requirements
* It improves future interpretability of the data
* It helps to adjust data for disabled users
* It summarized lengthy pieces of data into shorter abstracts


Solution
========
Adding metadata improves the future interpretability of the data.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
